messages.text:
"Create an original 3D video game with a distinctive visual identity and a genuinely innovative core gameplay mechanic that is fun from the very first seconds.

I want a fast-paced arcade experience that is easy to understand but offers strategic depth and unexpected situations. The concept must feel fresh and unique, not like a clone of an existing game.

Include an appealing 3D world, memorable characters, expressive animations, polished visual effects, and intuitive controls.

Design an addictive gameplay loop with progression, increasing challenges, and enough variety to make every playthrough feel different.

Prioritize a small, polished, highly entertaining experience over a massive project packed with unnecessary features.

Build a fully playable prototype, not just a visual demonstration.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Objective
- Build an original, polished, fully playable 3D arcade game prototype.

## Requirements
- Distinctive visual identity, innovative core mechanic, intuitive controls, escalating challenge, and replay variety.
- Prefer a small, polished experience over a large feature set.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for visual checks.

## Decisions
- Created **Mirror Current**, a survival arcade game where players collect tide-colored signal fruit and flip the tide to repel nearby hunters, setting up ricochets and collisions.
- Built it as a standalone Three.js HTML game with keyboard and touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented the 3D arena, courier, signal fruit, hunters, effects, HUD, scoring/chains, lives, escalating spawns, pause, restart, and high score.
- Verified JavaScript syntax and opened the game in a browser; captured and inspected gameplay screenshots.
